name: HTML - Headings & Structure
description: Learn about HTML headings and basic document structure

rules.text: Add a heading using the <h1> tag
rules.hint: Headings make text bigger and bolder. HTML has 6 heading sizes (h1-h6). Try: <h1>My Title</h1> above your paragraph. H1 is the largest!

rules.text: Include at least one paragraph with the <p> tag
rules.hint: Make sure you have a paragraph below your heading. Use <p>Your content here</p>

completion.message: 🎉 Excellent! You understand headings and structure!
